exposure: Infants exposed to at least one dose of ACS vs. those not exposed
outcome: Grade III or IV intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH)
cohort: 13,864 infants born between 23 and 34 weeks' gestation and weighing 500 to 1500 g at birth at Neocosur Neonatal Network centers during 2007-2016
finding: While ACS exposure was associated with a reduced risk of death in both singleton and multiple pregnancies, it was not associated with reduced odds of RDS or grade III or IV IVH in multiple pregnancies.
